_comment: Life-lessons index pointers that promise a topic file which does not contain them.
This is a RATCHET, not an allowance: the checker fails if a pointer appears here that is
not in this list. Fixing one means deleting its line. The list may only ever shrink.
WHY A BASELINE AND NOT A FIX: the bodies were never in the topic files -- they live in the
index. Making each pointer true means either moving a lesson or dropping its pointer, and
that is a curation judgement about someone else's corpus, not a mechanical rewrite.
What IS mechanical is refusing to let the list grow, which is what this does.
The open-gates register said 160 of 244 entries were affected. Measured at that gate's own
commit the index held TWENTY pointer lines in total. The real number, then and now, is below.
